```{r build-play-summary}
#Summarise each play's key characteristics
play_summary <- ball_events %>%
  group_by(game_string, play_per_game) %>%
  summarise(
    has_hit      = any(ball_eventcode == 4),
    has_wall_hit = any(ball_eventcode == 10),
    throw_count  = sum(ball_eventcode == 3),
    duration_s   = (max(timestamp) - min(timestamp)) / 1000,
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(!is.na(game_string), !is.na(play_per_game))  # drop NA artifact rows

# Step 2: Build runner context from lineups
runner_context <- lineups %>%
  select(game_string, play_per_game, on_1b, on_2b, on_3b) %>%
  distinct(game_string, play_per_game, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(runners_on_base = !is.na(on_1b) + !is.na(on_2b) + !is.na(on_3b)) %>%
  select(game_string, play_per_game, runners_on_base)

# Step 3: Join runner context in play_summary
play_summary <- play_summary %>%
  left_join(runner_context, by = c("game_string", "play_per_game"))
colnames(play_summary)
```

```{r find-candidates}
# Category A: Extra-base hit with runners on
extra_base_candidates <- play_summary %>%
  filter(has_hit == TRUE, runners_on_base >= 1, throw_count >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(throw_count), desc(duration_s)) %>%
  head(10)

# Category B: ball hit to wall with a relay
wall_candidates <- play_summary %>%
  filter(has_wall_hit == TRUE, throw_count >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(throw_count), desc(duration_s)) %>%

print(extra_base_candidates)
```

```{r verify-candidates}
create_play_by_play_fixed <- function(game_string_input, play_per_game_input) {
  
  # Convert player_id numbers to position labels
  player_position_definition <- function(code) {
    switch(as.character(code),
      "0" = "none", "1" = "pitcher", "2" = "catcher",
      "3" = "first baseman", "4" = "second baseman", "5" = "third baseman",
      "6" = "shortstop", "7" = "left fielder", "8" = "center fielder",
      "9" = "right fielder", "10" = "batter", "11" = "runner on first base",
      "12" = "runner on second base", "13" = "runner on third base",
      "14" = "home plate umpire", "15" = "field umpire", "16" = "field umpire",
      "17" = "field umpire", "18" = "first base coach", "19" = "third base coach",
      "255" = "ball event with no player"
    )
  }
  
  # Convert ball_eventcode numbers to easier to remember event labels
  game_events_definition <- function(code) {
    switch(as.character(code),
      "1" = "pitch thrown", "2" = "ball acquired", "3" = "throw (ball-in-play)",
      "4" = "ball hit into play", "5" = "end of play", "6" = "pickoff throw",
      "7" = "ball acquired - unknown field position",
      "8" = "throw (ball-in-play) - unknown field position",
      "9" = "ball deflection", "10" = "ball deflection off of wall",
      "11" = "home run", "16" = "ball bounce"
    )
  }
  
  # Filter to the specific play and build better play-by-play string
  ball_events %>%
    filter(game_string == game_string_input,
           play_per_game == play_per_game_input) %>%
    select(ball_eventcode, player_id) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(
      event  = map_chr(ball_eventcode, game_events_definition),
      player = map_chr(player_id, player_position_definition),
      pbp    = case_when(
        player != "none" & ball_eventcode != 16 ~ paste(event, "by", player),
        .default = event
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(pbp) %>%
    paste(collapse = ", ") %>%
    tools::toTitleCase()
}

# Verify top candidates
create_play_by_play_fixed("y1_d198_JGO_VAS", 94)   # Wall deflection 
create_play_by_play_fixed("y1_d133_ARN_VAS", 89)   # Wall deflection 
create_play_by_play_fixed("y1_d084_NXS_ARN", 55)   # Extra-base hit 
create_play_by_play_fixed("y1_d139_VAS_ARN", 219)  # Extra-base hit
```

```{r phase2-extract-play1}
# For each selected play, extract only the columns and rows needed for the
# web app. keeps JSON files small
#(Extra-base hit): y1_d110_SPL_PHD, play 171
#(Wall deflection): y1_d207_ATL_PHD, play 91  
#(Close play at plate): y1_d197_ARN_PHD, play 220

# Helper function: extract all tracking data for one play
# Returns a list with ball positions, runner positions, and timestamps
extract_play_data <- function(game_string_input, play_per_game_input) {
  
  # Step 1: Get key timestamps
  # need to know exactly when the ball was hit and when play ended
  events <- ball_events %>%
    filter(game_string == game_string_input,
           play_per_game == play_per_game_input) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(timestamp, ball_eventcode, player_id), as.numeric))
  
  # Timestamp when ball was put into play (eventcode 4)
  t_hit <- events %>%
    filter(ball_eventcode == 4) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(timestamp)
  
  # Timestamp when play ended (eventcode 5)
  t_end <- events %>%
    filter(ball_eventcode == 5) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(timestamp)
  
  # Step 2: Extract ball positions from hit to end of play
  ball <- ball_positions %>%
    filter(game_string == game_string_input,
           play_per_game == play_per_game_input) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(timestamp, ball_position_x, 
                    ball_position_y, ball_position_z), as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(timestamp >= t_hit, timestamp <= t_end) %>%
    select(timestamp, x = ball_position_x, 
           y = ball_position_y, z = ball_position_z)
  
  # Step 3: runner positions (player_ids 10-13 = batter + runners) 
  #only care about offensive players for the game
  runners <- player_positions %>%
    filter(game_string == game_string_input,
           play_per_game == play_per_game_input) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(timestamp, field_x, field_y, player_id), as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(player_id >= 10, player_id <= 13,        # offense only
           timestamp >= t_hit, timestamp <= t_end) %>%
    select(timestamp, player_id, x = field_x, y = field_y)
  
  # Step 4: Get lineup context for play
  # This tells us which bases were occupied
  lineup_context <- lineups %>%
    filter(game_string == game_string_input,
           play_per_game == play_per_game_input) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    select(on_1b, on_2b, on_3b, batter)
  
  # Step 5: Package into a list
  list(
    game_string    = game_string_input,
    play_per_game  = play_per_game_input,
    t_hit          = t_hit,
    t_end          = t_end,
    duration_s     = (t_end - t_hit) / 1000,
    lineup         = lineup_context,
    ball           = ball,
    runners        = runners
  )
}

# Extract all three plays
play1_data <- extract_play_data("y1_d110_SPL_PHD", 171)
play2_data <- extract_play_data("y1_d207_ATL_PHD", 91)
play3_data <- extract_play_data("y1_d197_ARN_PHD", 220)

#check
cat("Play 1 duration:", play1_data$duration_s, "seconds\n")
cat("Play 1 ball positions:", nrow(play1_data$ball), "frames\n")
cat("Play 1 runner positions:", nrow(play1_data$runners), "frames\n\n")

cat("Play 2 duration:", play2_data$duration_s, "seconds\n")
cat("Play 2 ball positions:", nrow(play2_data$ball), "frames\n")
cat("Play 2 runner positions:", nrow(play2_data$runners), "frames\n\n")

cat("Play 3 duration:", play3_data$duration_s, "seconds\n")
cat("Play 3 ball positions:", nrow(play3_data$ball), "frames\n")
cat("Play 3 runner positions:", nrow(play3_data$runners), "frames\n")
```

```{r phase2-time-to-base}
# Using field coordinates, find the moment each runner was
# closest to each base and calculate  time since the ball was hit.
# This "time to base" value is what fans will guess in the game.

# Base coordinates in the SMT coordinate system (feet)
bases <- tibble(
  base     = c("home", "first", "second", "third"),
  base_x   = c(0,      63.63,   0,        -63.63),
  base_y   = c(0,      63.63,   127.27,    63.63)
)

# Helper function: find time each runner reached each base
calculate_time_to_base <- function(play_data) {
  
  runners <- play_data$runners
  t_hit   <- play_data$t_hit
  
  # For each runner, calculate distance to each base at every timestamp
  runners %>%
    crossing(bases) %>%                       
    mutate(
      dist_to_base = sqrt((x - base_x)^2 + (y - base_y)^2),  # distance formula
      elapsed_s    = (timestamp - t_hit) / 1000               # seconds since hit
    ) %>%
    # For each runner + base combo, find the timestamp of closest
    group_by(player_id, base) %>%
    slice_min(dist_to_base, n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Only keep base touches where the runner actually got close  (10 feet)
    filter(dist_to_base <= 10) %>%
    select(player_id, base, elapsed_s, dist_to_base) %>%
    arrange(player_id, elapsed_s)
}

# Calculate for all three plays
play1_times <- calculate_time_to_base(play1_data)
play2_times <- calculate_time_to_base(play2_data)
play3_times <- calculate_time_to_base(play3_data)

# Print results
cat("=== Play 1 (Extra-base hit) ===\n")
print(play1_times)

cat("\n=== Play 2 (Wall deflection) ===\n")
print(play2_times)

cat("\n=== Play 3 (Close play at plate) ===\n")
print(play3_times)
```

```{r phase2-calculate-speed}
# Speed is calculatwd from position change between consecutive timestamps.
# Distance / time gives feet per second, which is normalized to a 0-1 scale
# for coloring in the app (0 = stopped, 1 = top sprint speed).
SPRINT_CAP_FT_S <- 35  # feet per second at full sprint (ceiling)
# Helper: calculate speed for one play's runner data
add_speed <- function(runners_df, t_hit) {
  runners_df %>%
    arrange(player_id, timestamp) %>%
    group_by(player_id) %>%
    mutate(
      dt_s        = (timestamp - lag(timestamp)) / 1000,  # time delta in seconds
      dx          = x - lag(x),                            # x displacement
      dy          = y - lag(y),                            # y displacement
      dist_ft     = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2),                     # distance in feet
      speed_ft_s  = dist_ft / dt_s,                        # feet per second
      # Normalize to 0-1 scale capped at sprint speed
      speed_norm  = pmin(speed_ft_s / SPRINT_CAP_FT_S, 1),
      # Replace NA on first row of each runner with 0
      speed_norm  = replace_na(speed_norm, 0),
      # Time since hit in milliseconds for the app
      t           = round(timestamp - t_hit)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(t, player_id, x = x, y = y, speed_norm)
}

# Calculate speed for all three plays
play1_runners_speed <- add_speed(play1_data$runners, play1_data$t_hit)
play2_runners_speed <- add_speed(play2_data$runners, play2_data$t_hit)
play3_runners_speed <- add_speed(play3_data$runners, play3_data$t_hit)

# Quick check
cat("Play 1 speed range:", 
    round(min(play1_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "to",
    round(max(play1_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "\n")

cat("Play 2 speed range:", 
    round(min(play2_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "to",
    round(max(play2_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "\n")

cat("Play 3 speed range:", 
    round(min(play3_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "to",
    round(max(play3_runners_speed$speed_norm, na.rm=T), 2), "\n")
```

```{r phase2-reexport-with-defenders}
# We add defensive player positions (player_ids 1-9) to the JSON so the
# scoreboard replay shows the full field picture, not just runners.
library(jsonlite)

export_play_json_v3 <- function(play_data, play_times,
                                 runners_speed, play_label, filename) {

  # Ball positions, ms since hit
  ball_clean <- play_data$ball %>%
    mutate(
      t = round(timestamp - play_data$t_hit),
      x = round(x, 2),
      y = round(y, 2),
      z = round(z, 2)
    ) %>%
    select(t, x, y, z)

  # Runner positions with speed for trail coloring (player_ids 10-13)
  runners_clean <- runners_speed %>%
    mutate(
      x          = round(x, 2),
      y          = round(y, 2),
      speed_norm = round(speed_norm, 3),
      player_id  = as.integer(player_id)
    ) %>%
    select(t, player_id, x, y, speed_norm)

  # Defender positions (player_ids 1-9)
  defenders_clean <- player_positions %>%
    filter(game_string == play_data$game_string,
           play_per_game == play_data$play_per_game) %>%
    collect() %>%
    mutate(across(c(timestamp, field_x, field_y, player_id), as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(player_id >= 1, player_id <= 9,
           timestamp >= play_data$t_hit,
           timestamp <= play_data$t_end) %>%
    mutate(
      t         = round(timestamp - play_data$t_hit),
      x         = round(field_x, 2),
      y         = round(field_y, 2),
      player_id = as.integer(player_id)
    ) %>%
    select(t, player_id, x, y)

  # Time-to-base answers for the guessing game reveal
  answers <- play_times %>%
    mutate(elapsed_s = round(elapsed_s, 2)) %>%
    select(player_id, base, elapsed_s)

  # Full payload
  payload <- list(
    meta = list(
      label         = play_label,
      game_string   = play_data$game_string,
      play_per_game = play_data$play_per_game,
      duration_s    = round(play_data$duration_s, 2)
    ),
    answers   = answers,
    ball      = ball_clean,
    runners   = runners_clean,
    defenders = defenders_clean
  )

  write_json(payload, filename, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  cat("Exported:", filename, "\n")
}

#export all three plays with defender data
export_play_json_v3(
  play1_data, play1_times, play1_runners_speed,
  "Extra-base hit with relay throws",
  "play1_extra_base.json"
)

export_play_json_v3(
  play2_data, play2_times, play2_runners_speed,
  "Wall deflection chaos play",
  "play2_wall_deflection.json"
)

export_play_json_v3(
  play3_data, play3_times, play3_runners_speed,
  "Close play at the plate",
  "play3_close_play.json"
)
```
